w10_T4_000218: The parking attendant records the meter tray in cents and never converts it into dollars. At opening the tray held 173 cents, and a driver added 50 cents. The attendant emptied 191 cents into the collection bag and calls whatever stays in the tray the float. Later drivers put 70 cents into the float, then 92 cents of jammed coins were pulled out of it, and 5 cents rolled away under the kerb. How many cents are in the float?
w10_T4_000219: Hamid had logged 67 minutes of violin practice on Monday. He moved a full hour, which is 60 minutes, into his lesson log, and the remainder became his free-practice log. On Tuesday he added 55 minutes to the free-practice log, then his teacher reclassified 51 of those minutes as a lesson, and 2 minutes were struck out for a timing error. His sister Laila's free-practice log shows more minutes than Hamid's. How many minutes are on Hamid's free-practice log?
w10_T4_000220: Chloe had 139 bean seeds and planted 70 of them in the school plot. Her friend Jamal has fewer seeds than Chloe. The garden bed is 15 metres long. Chloe then doubled her remaining seeds by buying the same number again at the market. Each of her seeds grew into a plant with 7 pods, and each pod held 5 beans. How many beans did Chloe's seeds produce?
w10_T4_000230: Sam had 138 books on his shelves. He picked up 26 more at a library sale, then donated 105 to a charity shop. He lent 50 books to his friend Priya, who now has more books than Sam. Priya's shelf, which is a dozen feet long, can hold up to 200 books. Sam later bought 73 books at a fair. How many books does Sam have now?
w10_T4_000234: Joel's daily study plan has 108 minutes of reading, 55 minutes of maths, and one hour of music, which is 60 minutes. He follows the plan every day, 7 days a week, for 5 weeks. Over that time he missed 4998 minutes of the plan through illness, and his tutor added a 71 minute extra session at the end. His friend Rina studied fewer minutes than Joel over the same weeks. How many minutes did Joel study in total?
w10_T4_000235: The stadium had 237 season-ticket holders, and 38 more joined this year. The loyalty scheme started 3 years ago. Each holder receives 8 match tickets, and the club also issued 25 complimentary tickets to volunteers. Every ticket issued earns 6 loyalty points in the scheme. How many loyalty points did the club issue?
w10_T4_000238: In the morning the bottling plant filled 235 crates an hour for 7 hours, and 32 crates were left from the day before. In the afternoon every crate was opened, each holding 4 bottles, and the bottles were repacked into gift boxes of 4. In the evening 1370 gift boxes were shipped out. How many gift boxes remain at the plant?
w10_T4_000241: A print shop had 9 reams of paper with 216 sheets in each. The printer runs at 30 pages a minute. The shop used 238 sheets for flyers and 1665 sheets for a booklet, and then found 21 loose sheets in a drawer. Each remaining sheet was cut into 4 cards, and the cards were shared equally between 2 shops. How many cards does the first shop receive?
w10_T4_000243: In the morning the creamery received 110 crates with 6 pints of milk in each, plus a second load of 54 pints. The delivery van made 3 trips. In the afternoon the milk was poured into cups, with 2 cups to a pint. In the evening the kitchen brought out 36 more cups. How many cups of milk are there?
w10_T4_000244: In the morning the news stall had 81 magazines, and a delivery of 60 more arrived; the owner, who has run the stall for a dozen years, put every magazine into the front rack. In the afternoon 52 magazines were sold from the rack, and then 47 more. In the evening 32 were sold and 5 damaged copies were removed. How many magazines are in the front rack?
w10_T4_000247: The school library had 95 chairs and received 61 more from the town hall. The library building is 40 years old. Every chair comes with 2 cushions, and the librarian found 21 spare cushions in a cupboard. Then 83 worn cushions were thrown out. How many cushions does the library have?
w10_T4_000251: In the morning the data centre had 189 racks with 2 shelves each, and 9 servers sat on every shelf. In the afternoon the technicians counted 6 drives in each server and 4 partitions on each drive. In the evening every partition was stored as 2 copies in the backup index, and 47 archival copies were added to the index. How many copies does the backup index list?
w10_T4_000252: The running club meets twice a week. On Monday its members logged 67 kilometres, then 47 kilometres on Tuesday, 67 on Wednesday, 24 on Thursday, and 71 on Friday. For the season challenge every kilometre logged is worth 9 challenge points. How many challenge points does the club have?
w10_T4_000256: Oliver pressed 12 gallons of apple juice on Friday, 46 gallons on Saturday, and 47 gallons on Sunday. His neighbour Grace pressed fewer gallons than Oliver. He bottles the juice in pints, with 8 pints to a gallon, and sent the pints in equal shares to 4 markets. At the first market the pints were arranged equally across 5 shelves. How many pints are on the top shelf at the first market?
w10_T4_000259: The theatre sold 163 tickets online, 25 by phone, and 12 at the door. Every ticket cost 9 dollars, and a patron added a 12 dollar donation to the takings. The production costs came to 1717 dollars, and the profit was shared equally among 5 cast members. How many dollars does the lead actor receive?
w10_T4_000261: Fatima had 168 photos on her camera. She uploaded half of them to her online album. Over the week she added 21 photos from her phone, 37 from a friend, and 27 from a trip. Then she removed 94 blurry photos from the album. How many photos are in the album?
w10_T4_000263: In the morning the baker had 117 muffins and baked the same number again, doubling her stock, and sold 226 of them. In the afternoon she gave 2 muffins to a taster, then cut each remaining muffin into 2 pieces for samples. In the evening she topped each piece with 3 berries. How many berries did she use?
w10_T4_000272: In the morning the bike-share station had 118 bikes; riders took 33, and 9 were sent for repair, and the staff moved every remaining bike to the east dock. Riders may keep a bike for half an hour at a time. In the afternoon 27 bikes were returned to the east dock. In the evening 36 bikes were taken from the east dock. How many bikes are in the east dock?
w10_T4_000275: In the morning Aisha's stall had 227 oranges, and deliveries brought 69 and then 71 more. In the afternoon a neighbour gave her 20 oranges and she sold 66. Her cousin Bilal's stall had fewer oranges than Aisha's all day. In the evening she packed her oranges equally into 3 crates. How many oranges are in the first crate?
w10_T4_000281: In the morning site manager Lena planned 205 weeks of work and wrote it up in days, at 7 days to a week, then added 23 days for inspections. In the afternoon she worked out that each day needs 6 workers, and each worker-day is billed at 7 credits. In the evening she copied the bill for 5 identical sites. Her rival Kwame's quote came to fewer credits than Lena's. How many credits is Lena's bill?
w10_T4_000285: In the morning the bakery received 182 boxes of eggs with 6 eggs in each, plus 37 loose eggs, which the cook checked twice. In the afternoon the farm sent 35 more eggs. In the evening every egg went into the pancake batter, and each egg makes 4 pancakes. How many pancakes did the bakery make?
w10_T4_000297: Nadia's coin jar held 138 cents. She dropped in 50 cents, which is half a dollar, and later 52 cents more. The jar is 20 centimetres tall. She took out 147 cents for a bus fare and then added 65 cents. How many cents are in the jar?
w10_T4_000300: Zoe had 113 beads. She used 47 on a bracelet and shared the rest equally between herself and Max, so the 2 of them got the same amount. Zoe then bought 74 beads and was given 26 more, but she used 120 beads on a necklace, so Max now has more beads than Zoe. How many beads does Zoe have?
w10_T4_000301: A school car wash charges 9 quarters per car. On each of 2 days, 30 cars came through. The students changed all the quarters into dollars, at 4 quarters to the dollar. They spent 34 dollars on soap and 10 dollars on wax. How many dollars do they have left?
w10_T4_000303: Ben planned 14 weeks for his seedlings and wrote it on a countdown calendar in days, at 7 days to a week. He added 67 days for hardening off the plants. After a warm spell he crossed 103 days off the calendar. Then a cold forecast made him add 45 days back. How many days are on the countdown calendar?
